salvo: salvo14/mig/s6 (9 Nov 2026), lot k-openai-1 (b-openai + c-openai). LLM simulation of age gaps in loneliness (2022 EU Loneliness Survey, UCLA-3 scale 3-9; France, Italy, Poland, Sweden; ages 18-34 vs 65+). GPT-5.6 Terra rows of Table 2: S (age-specified simulation) and D (direct estimation) in the four countries, 8 signed gap errors versus the EU4 probability-based human reference (the research line held the France block only; the 'country of the following blocks not verified' doubt is resolved from the Country column). Younger mean, older mean and gap of each row are kept in the measure notes. A calibration measure (sociological), not a capability ranking: doubt flag. GPT-5.6 Terra through the OpenAI API (id gpt-5.6-terra), temperature 0.7, output cap 256, reasoning or thinking modes disabled where the endpoint exposed them. The HTML copy is held in the c-openai/arx evidence folder.
